lines.trans: What is this unscheduled family council?
Dad, sit down, I want to say something important.
Tell me honestly, are you pregnant right now?
Mom, no, I am not pregnant at all.
I am leaving soon to live in Paris.
Are you going there with that clown?
It would be better if you really were pregnant!

words.gram: feminine singular, nominative; used as a side word

lines.trans: Has he already asked you to marry him?
No, so far he only invited me to Paris.
And what about your mother and me?
You lived wonderfully before my arrival.
And each of you lived on your own.

words.gloss: and that, what is more, moreover
yourself (в себе = in one's right mind)
